name: Rescue Sita
author: NIMMEN
description: | Play as Lord Ram on a mission to rescue your kidnapped wife, Sita, from the clutches of the malevolent Ravan.  Encounter Different puzzles and enemies, traps, collect coins to increase score, make you way to Ravan solving these puzzles and destroying anyone who comes in the way!(Ravan wont die unless you meet the monk-who grants u the special arrow to kill Ravan) | (Don't forget to unmute audio in bottom right)                                                                                                                        Difficulty Level - Medium/Hard                                                    GamesControls:                                                                                                    1] A/D or left-arrow/right-arrow to move.  2] press spacebar to jump.  3] Press left click to fire arrows using a bow and kill enemies on your way!  4] to climb ladders press W/S or up-arrow/down-arrow 5] bounce on mushrooms to gain extra bounciness!  Good luck :D .
